verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a way to authenticate Grok Build with an API key instead of an account login. The only documented auth option is `--device-auth`, which is a device-code flow for an account login. Community reports describe login gated on a SuperGrok subscription. Custom-model config and the separate xAI API are adjacent features, not API-key authentication for the CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
